defmodule SecureAPI.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  # Allowlisted safe modules for data export
  @safe_modules %{
    "json" => SecureAPI.Exporters.JsonExporter,
    "csv" => SecureAPI.Exporters.CsvExporter,
    "xml" => SecureAPI.Exporters.XmlExporter
  }

  # Allowlisted safe transform functions
  @safe_transforms MapSet.new(["upcase", "downcase", "trim", "reverse"])

  post "/api/export" do
    with {:ok, user} <- authenticate(conn),
         {:ok, params} <- validate_export_params(conn.body_params),
         :ok <- authorize_export(user, params) do
      result = SecureAPI.Pipeline.execute(params, user)
      send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", data: result}))
    else
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
    end
  end

  defp authenticate(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "x-api-key") do
      [key] -> SecureAPI.Auth.verify_key(key)
      _ -> {:error, "missing api key"}
    end
  end

  defp validate_export_params(params) do
    required = ["format", "dataset", "transforms"]
    if Enum.all?(required, &Map.has_key?(params, &1)) do
      {:ok, params}
    else
      {:error, "missing required fields"}
    end
  end

  defp authorize_export(user, params) do
    if user.role in [:admin, :analyst] do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, "insufficient permissions"}
    end
  end
end

defmodule SecureAPI.Auth do
  @api_keys %{
    "ak_admin_9x8f2" => %{id: 1, role: :admin, name: "admin"},
    "ak_analyst_3k9d" => %{id: 2, role: :analyst, name: "analyst"},
    "ak_viewer_1m4p" => %{id: 3, role: :viewer, name: "viewer"}
  }

  def verify_key(key) do
    case Map.get(@api_keys, key) do
      nil -> {:error, "invalid key"}
      user -> {:ok, user}
    end
  end
end

defmodule SecureAPI.Pipeline do
  @moduledoc """
  Secure data processing pipeline with allowlisted operations.
  All transforms are validated against a static allowlist before execution.
  """

  @safe_transforms MapSet.new(["upcase", "downcase", "trim", "reverse"])
  @safe_formats %{
    "json" => SecureAPI.Exporters.JsonExporter,
    "csv" => SecureAPI.Exporters.CsvExporter,
    "xml" => SecureAPI.Exporters.XmlExporter
  }

  @allowed_custom_transforms %{
    {SecureAPI.Transforms.String, :capitalize} => true,
    {SecureAPI.Transforms.String, :slug} => true
  }

  def execute(params, user) do
    dataset = fetch_dataset(params["dataset"])
    transforms = parse_transforms(params["transforms"])
    format = params["format"]

    dataset
    |> apply_transforms(transforms, user)
    |> export(format)
  end

  defp fetch_dataset(name) when name in ["sales", "inventory", "users"] do
    # Simulated data fetch from safe source
    [%{"id" => 1, "value" => "sample_data_#{name}"}]
  end
  defp fetch_dataset(_), do: [%{"id" => 0, "value" => "empty"}]

  defp parse_transforms(transforms) when is_list(transforms), do: transforms
  defp parse_transforms(transforms) when is_binary(transforms) do
    transforms |> String.split(",") |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
  end
  defp parse_transforms(_), do: []

  defp apply_transforms(data, transforms, user) do
    validated = validate_transform_chain(transforms, user)
    Enum.reduce(validated, data, fn transform, acc ->
      execute_transform(acc, transform)
    end)
  end

  defp validate_transform_chain(transforms, user) do
    Enum.filter(transforms, fn t ->
      is_safe_transform?(t) || has_custom_transform_permission?(user, t)
    end)
  end

  defp is_safe_transform?(transform) do
    # Normalize and check against allowlist
    normalized = transform |> String.downcase() |> String.trim()
    MapSet.member?(@safe_transforms, normalized)
  end

  defp has_custom_transform_permission?(user, transform) do
    # Admins can use custom transforms via module dispatch
    user.role == :admin && String.contains?(transform, ":")
  end

  defp execute_transform(data, transform) do
    cond do
      transform == "upcase" ->
        Enum.map(data, fn row -> Map.update!(row, "value", &String.upcase/1) end)
      transform == "downcase" ->
        Enum.map(data, fn row -> Map.update!(row, "value", &String.downcase/1) end)
      transform == "trim" ->
        Enum.map(data, fn row -> Map.update!(row, "value", &String.trim/1) end)
      transform == "reverse" ->
        Enum.map(data, fn row -> Map.update!(row, "value", &String.reverse/1) end)
      String.contains?(transform, ":") ->
        dispatch_custom_transform(data, transform)
      true ->
        data
    end
  end

  defp dispatch_custom_transform(data, transform) do
    [mod_str, func_str] = String.split(transform, ":", parts: 2)
    module = Module.concat(["SecureAPI", "Transforms", String.capitalize(mod_str)])
    func = String.to_existing_atom(func_str)
    # Security: validate against allowlist of permitted module/function pairs
    if Map.has_key?(@allowed_custom_transforms, {module, func}) do
      apply(module, func, [data])
    else
      Logger.warning("Blocked unauthorized custom transform: #{module}.#{func}")
      data
    end
  end

  defp export(data, format) do
    case Map.get(@safe_formats, format) do
      nil -> Jason.encode!(data)
      module -> apply(module, :export, [data])
    end
  end
end

defmodule SecureAPI.Exporters.JsonExporter do
  def export(data), do: Jason.encode!(data)
end

defmodule SecureAPI.Exporters.CsvExporter do
  def export(data) do
    data
    |> Enum.map(fn row ->
      row |> Map.values() |> Enum.map(&escape_csv_field/1) |> Enum.join(",")
    end)
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  # Neutralize CSV/formula injection and properly quote fields.
  defp escape_csv_field(value) do
    str = to_string(value)

    # Prefix a single quote to neutralize formula injection when the field
    # begins with a character interpreted as a formula by spreadsheet apps.
    neutralized =
      if String.match?(str, ~r/^[=+\-@\t\r]/) do
        "'" <> str
      else
        str
      end

    # Always quote and escape embedded double quotes to keep CSV structure intact.
    escaped = String.replace(neutralized, "\"", "\"\"")
    "\"" <> escaped <> "\""
  end
end

defmodule SecureAPI.Exporters.XmlExporter do
  def export(data) do
    rows = Enum.map(data, fn row ->
      fields = Enum.map(row, fn {k, v} ->
        tag = escape_xml_name(to_string(k))
        "<#{tag}>#{escape_xml(to_string(v))}</#{tag}>"
      end)
      "<row>#{Enum.join(fields)}</row>"
    end)
    "<data>#{Enum.join(rows)}</data>"
  end

  # Escape XML special characters in text content to prevent XML injection.
  defp escape_xml(text) do
    text
    |> String.replace("&", "&")
    |> String.replace("<", "<")
    |> String.replace(">", ">")
    |> String.replace("\"", """)
    |> String.replace("'", "'")
  end

  # Sanitize element names so keys cannot inject markup or invalid tags.
  defp escape_xml_name(name) do
    sanitized = String.replace(name, ~r/[^A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]/, "_")
    if sanitized == "" or String.match?(sanitized, ~r/^[0-9\-\.]/) do
      "_" <> sanitized
    else
      sanitized
    end
  end
end

defmodule SecureAPI.Transforms.String do
  def capitalize(data) do
    Enum.map(data, fn row -> Map.update!(row, "value", &String.capitalize/1) end)
  end

  def slug(data) do
    Enum.map(data, fn row ->
      Map.update!(row, "value", fn v ->
        v |> String.downcase() |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9]/, "-")
      end)
    end)
  end
end
